verdicts.explanation: The 8.99 × 10−3 S cm−1 bulk value at 650 °C for LMO is reported in the Transport correlation section and attributed to Shiwankar et al. [15], so literature_cited is correct. The null secondary fields are acceptable because the paper gives no sintering, density or activation-energy value tied to this record.

The 2.07 × 10−2 S cm−1 bulk value at 650 °C is given for LMOG3 (x = 0.3) and cited to Shiwankar et al. [15], so the material, value, temperature and literature_cited origin all check out. Secondary fields are null, which is acceptable.

The 1.54 × 10−3 S cm−1 bulk value at 650 °C is given for LMOG4 (x = 0.4) and cited to Shiwankar et al. [15], so the record is correct as literature_cited. The Ea of 1.46 eV is correctly left unattached.
